title: Board Efficiency Model — Framework v1 (8 Boards) vs. Framework v2 (5 Boards)
purpose: Compare Framework v1's 8-board model against Framework v2's 5-board consolidated model. Measure decision latency, duplicate decisions, and escalation rates to validate that the consolidation delivers the promised efficiency improvements.

boards.name: Technical Review Board
boards.function: Technical accuracy verification — accounting calculations, concept application
boards.duplicate_scope: 55% overlap with EQS on explanation quality, 40% with DQS on distractor logic

boards.name: DQS — Distractor Quality Score
boards.function: Distractor plausibility, choice quality, wrong-answer educational value
boards.duplicate_scope: 70% overlap with EQS — distractor explanations are the same artifact

boards.name: EQS — Explanation Quality Score
boards.function: Explanation clarity, completeness, pedagogical value, citation standards
boards.duplicate_scope: 70% overlap with DQS, 60% with Technical — EW fields examined 4-7× per session

boards.name: UIQS — User Interface Quality Score
boards.function: UI rendering, cross-browser display, question layout
boards.duplicate_scope: 15% overlap with QA Board — lowest overlap board

boards.name: Learner Safety Review
boards.function: Learner-pool protection: wrong answers, misleading content, safety violations
boards.duplicate_scope: 70% overlap with QA Board — heavily redundant

boards.name: Certification Board
boards.function: Final certification adjudication — signs off on all other board verdicts
boards.duplicate_scope: Hierarchical — receives and re-reviews all other board verdicts

boards.name: Readiness Review Board
boards.function: Session readiness assessment, governance compliance, phase-gate authorization
boards.duplicate_scope: 60% overlap with Launch Board on governance checks

meta_boards.name: Launch Board
meta_boards.function: Session initialization, board coordination, task assignment

meta_boards.name: Archival Board
meta_boards.function: Artifact archival, backup verification, legacy file management

v1_inefficiencies.cross_board_overlap: DQS↔EQS overlap = 70%. Learner Safety↔QA overlap = 70%. Technical↔EQS overlap = 60%. The EW fields were the most duplicated review target.
v1_inefficiencies.decision_duplication: Per-wave: ~500 items × 8 boards = ~4,000 board-level reviews. But distinctive review actions: ~500 items × (1.0 technical + 1.0 quality + 0.5 learner safety) = ~1,250 genuinely distinct. Duplication ratio: ~3.2:1 at board level.
v1_inefficiencies.escalation_pattern: Items escalated from one content board to another 2-3 times before reaching Certification Board. No consolidated escalation path.

framework_v2_boards.label: Framework v2 — 5 Board Model
framework_v2_boards.composition: 3 operational boards + 1 meta board + 1 measurement board

boards.name: Registry Board
boards.function: Identity resolution, canonical registry maintenance, compound-key management, delta ledger maintenance
boards.unique_scope: Identity management — no board overlap. Gate -1 and Gate 3 produce identity artifacts consumed by all other boards.
boards.v2_target_duplication: 0% — identity resolved once, consumed by all

boards.name: Quality Board
boards.function: Unified quality review — 3-agent pass covering all 6 v1 content board scopes in a single review. All CAQS dimensions assessed by one board.
boards.unique_scope: Single board pass replaces 6 v1 boards. No cross-board overlap.
boards.v2_target_decision_latency: <0.5 sessions (pre-flight catches structural issues; Quality Board only reviews READY items)
boards.v2_target_duplication: <5% (only necessary confirmatory checks between agents A/B/C)

boards.name: Governance Board
boards.function: Session authorization, phase-gate enforcement, governance compliance, portfolio safety, escalation management
boards.unique_scope: Governance oversight — no content review function. Consumes scan artifacts and readiness classifications.
boards.v2_target_decision_latency: <0.25 sessions (automated governance guard checks + session arbiter)

boards.name: Certification Board
boards.function: Final certification adjudication. Reviews Quality Board verdicts and authorizes question_state transitions. No longer re-reviews all other board outputs — trusts Quality Board with spot-check verification.
boards.unique_scope: Go/No-Go on certification batches. 2-agent consensus (Certification Agent A + Certification Agent B).

boards.name: Throughput Board
boards.function: Pure measurement — tracks all BF metrics, throughput, efficiency, and cost. No content review authority. No certification authority. Measurement only.
boards.unique_scope: Measurement-only accountability. Added by S202 Amendment 2 to ensure throughput targets are independently tracked.

v2_efficiency_gains.cross_board_overlap_eliminated: DQS↔EQS 70% overlap eliminated. Learner Safety↔QA 70% overlap eliminated. Technical↔EQS 60% overlap eliminated. Quality Board performs single unified pass.
v2_efficiency_gains.decision_latency_reduction: v1: 4-5 sessions per wave. v2 target: 1-2 sessions. -67%.
v2_efficiency_gains.duplicate_decision_elimination: v1: ~3.2:1 board-level duplication ratio. v2 target: <1.2:1.

board_comparison_matrix.v1_value: 8.5 (range 8-9: all 8 boards operate most sessions; Launch and Readiness operate every session)
board_comparison_matrix.v2_target: 4.5 (range 4-5: not all boards convene every session. Registry runs every T0. Quality/Governance/Certification run per session. Throughput may not convene separately — metrics integrated into Governance report.)

BE-001_decision_latency.description: Time from item entering board queue to board issuing a verdict. Measured in session-equivalents.
BE-001_decision_latency.formula: decision_latency = sessions_elapsed between item_queued and board_verdict_issued

BE-002_duplicate_decisions.description: Rate at which multiple boards issue the same verdict on the same item. In v1, DQS and EQS frequently agreed (95%+ of the time on EW assessments) but both issued independent verdicts.
BE-002_duplicate_decisions.v1_baseline: ~55% of board verdicts are duplicates (same item, same finding, different board)
BE-002_duplicate_decisions.v2_target: <5% (Quality Board single-pass eliminates nearly all cross-board duplication)

BE-003_escalation_rate.description: Rate at which items are escalated from one board to another for deeper review. High escalation indicates the pre-flight isn't catching issues before board review.
BE-003_escalation_rate.v1_baseline: ~15-20% (items frequently escalated between Technical→EQS→DQS→Learner Safety before reaching Certification)
BE-003_escalation_rate.v2_target: <5% (pre-flight catches issues before board review. Quality Board handles most concerns internally without escalation.)

BE-004_board_workload_balance.description: Distribution of review work across boards. v1 had uneven workload — Technical Review Board handled 100% of items while Readiness Board handled ~20% (only escalated items).
BE-004_board_workload_balance.v1_baseline: High imbalance — Technical and Certification boards touch every item; Readiness touches 20%; UIQS touches ~30%
BE-004_board_workload_balance.v2_target: Low imbalance — Registry/Governance touch every item (automated). Quality touches all READY items. Certification touches all CERTIFIABLE items. Imbalance is acceptable because boards have different scope depth.

v1_escalation.description: Ad-hoc escalation: any agent could escalate to any board. Items routinely bounced between 3-4 boards before certification.
v1_escalation.typical_path: Technical Review → DQS → EQS → Learner Safety → QA → Certification (6 stages, 3-4 of which duplicated work)
v1_escalation.problem: No formal escalation criteria. Agents escalated based on individual judgment, not documented gates.

v2_escalation.description: Formal 3-tier escalation with gate conditions (per S203 Gate State Machine).

tiers.name: Quality Board Internal
tiers.trigger: Agent disagreement within Quality Board (2 agents CERTIFY, 1 HOLD)
tiers.resolution: Quality Board Lead adjudicates. No external escalation.

tiers.name: Governance Board Escalation
tiers.trigger: DL-030 CONFIRMED or DL-008 on Certified item or readiness leakage event
tiers.resolution: Governance Board reviews and issues binding directive. Item may revert to REMEDIATE.

tiers.name: Structural Repair
tiers.trigger: Identity failure, compound-key collision, JSON corruption
tiers.resolution: Manual structural repair required. Item enters EditorialQueue. Cannot be certified until repaired.

forbidden_escalations: Quality Board → Technical Review (doesn't exist in v2)
Certification Board → DQS/EQS (consolidated into Quality Board)
Any board → Readiness Board (consolidated into Governance Board)

measurements.boards_operational: 8 v1 boards still active. V2 boards not yet operational.
measurements.notes: Measurement baseline established. V2 board efficiency tracking begins at S830.
First measurement of v2 board consolidation effectiveness.
